To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the anomaly in the M-theory on S^1 x M_7, with a boundary, is cancelled by a shift in the definition of the current, and that the shift is given by a local, gauge invariant expression involving the curvatures of the E8 bundle and the gravitino and gaugino fields.

(i) the flux corrections to anomaly cancellation are local, (ii) they are of the type that can be obtained from a shift in the definition of the chiral current, (iii) they are proportional to the curvature of the internal manifold, (iv) they are proportional (in the case of M-theory) to the fluxes of the 3-form and 4-form potentials.

(a) the flux correction to the extended Dirac operator is of order $O(\alpha')^3$, not $O(\alpha'^{5/2})$ as claimed in the published version of this paper, and (b) the correction to the extended heat kernel expansion is of order $1/\alpha'^{3/2}$.
